$comment: The Budgets tab, the budget sheet, the Planned sheet and the reorder sheet.

screenTitle.note: Large title of the Budgets screen.

scopePicker.note: Title of the account picker opened from the scope pill.

direct.note: A line under a folder for what was filed on the folder itself (or the budget's own category), not on a category inside it.

travel.note: Fallback name of a trip's spending line when its tag is gone.

plannedOf.note: Stat label when some budgets are left out of Planned.

exceeded.message: {count, plural, one {One budget has gone over} other {# budgets have gone over}} — worth keeping in mind for the rest of the month.
exceeded.note: Note above the budgets, current period.

exceededEnded.message: {count, plural, one {One budget went over} other {# budgets went over}} — something to keep in mind next time.
exceededEnded.note: Note above the budgets, a period that is over.

emptyHint: Set a limit for a category or for everything; it renews every period.

monthly.note: Section header; period is "Aug 2026" or "15 Aug – 14 Sep".

monthlyScoped.note: Same, with the account or group being shown.

editLabel.note: VoiceOver label of a budget row.

reorderHint: Long press to reorder the budgets

notInPlanned.note: Lowercase, after a dot in a budget subtitle: this budget is left out of the Planned total.

spentOf.note: Under a budget bar: "1 200 of 3 000 EUR".

showCategories.message: Show the {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} it was spent on
showCategories.note: VoiceOver, the fold under a budget.

hideCategories.message: Hide the {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} it was spent on
hideCategories.note: VoiceOver, the fold under a budget.

childLabel.note: VoiceOver label of a category line; name is a category.

childTaggedLabel.note: VoiceOver label of a category line under a tag budget.

saved.note: A period that is over, under the limit; amount is "120.00 EUR".

title.note: Name of the Spending section (reorder sheet).

headerScoped.note: Same, with the account or group being shown.

allLabel.note: VoiceOver; name is a folder or trip.

allIn.note: First line inside an opened folder; name is a folder or trip.

noRate.message: No rate yet for {currencies}, so it is left out of the total.
noRate.note: currencies is a list of codes.

show.note: Button on the Travel history header; count is the number of past trips.

everything.note: Name of a budget that covers all spending.

tag.note: Fallback after # when a budget's tag is gone.

edit.noTagsBody: Create a tag in Settings → Tags first.
edit.tagPickerSubtitle: Every expense with this tag counts

monthlyLimit.note: Budget sheet subtitle part; parts are joined with " · ".

periodStart.note: Budget sheet subtitle part; day is 2–28.

onlyFor.note: Budget sheet subtitle part; account is an account name.

avg.message: Avg {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
avg.note: Suggestion chip: the average over the last N months.

avgAll.message: Avg all {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
avgAll.note: Suggestion chip: the average over all N months of history.

categories.note: Chip: choose the categories the budget covers.

name.note: Chip: give the budget a name of its own.

title.note: Sum of the budgets' limits; stat label and title of the sheet that explains it.

rowLeft.note: Subtitle of a counted budget; amount is "300.00 EUR", left is "120.00".

counted.message: {count, plural, =0 {No budget is counted.} one {One budget is counted.} other {# budgets are counted.}}

countedOff.message: {count, plural, =0 {No budget is counted} one {One budget is counted} other {# budgets are counted}}, {off} left out.
countedOff.note: off is the number of budgets switched off.

planned.intro: A budget you switch off keeps its place and its bar on Budgets — it just stops counting towards these two numbers.

reorder.title: Reorder budgets
reorder.hint: Drag by the grip on the right. Spending and Travel history move as whole sections.
reorder.emptyHint: Add one on the Budgets screen first.
